initial_zone_K.source: User cold-start air at 15 degC; all fabric states also 15 degC is an explicit integration assumption

initial_radiator_K.source: Illustrative radiator initially equilibrated with the 15 degC zone

outdoor_K.source: Illustrative held outdoor 5 degC, not BOPTEST weather

solar_W.source: Explicit zero absorbed solar on the six opaque C2 surfaces; existing solar physics/ports retained

duration_s.source: Illustrative 24-hour integration observation; no sizing or comfort-success assumption

max_step_s.source: Integration numerical setting, at most the default controller sample period; not a convergence result

checks.basis: Provisional numerical software checks for this passive, zero/nonnegative-gain integration fixture, not physical accuracy acceptance criteria
